taste:
The side salad is crisp, chilled and tangy, with a clear contrast between crunchy vegetables and juicy tomatoes. Torn iceberg lettuce provides the base, while cucumber slices add more crunch. Red onion rings bring a sharp edge that makes this more than a mild lettuce accompaniment. The cherry tomatoes offer a softer bite within the mix.

A light coating of vinaigrette supplies the acidity rather than a heavy dressing. That tang is particularly useful alongside a rich lasagne or hearty burger, where the cool vegetables provide a fresh textural contrast. Choose it when you want your side to balance the main rather than add more richness.
